reason: Both companies do FAA-certified aircraft modifications (STCs) and avionics-related work for aircraft operators. AerSale is mainly an aftermarket business: used parts, aircraft and engine sales and leasing, and MRO. Butler National is a diversified holding company that also makes defense electronics and wire harnesses and manages the Boot Hill Casino. AerSale has nothing comparable to the casino and gaming management business, which is a material part of Butler. So AerSale matches only the aerospace part of Butler, and the grade is capped at 1.
